principles: The failure mode is decay without detection: every mechanism has been built at least once. Each self-correction mechanism needs a liveness expectation of the form 'fired on real traffic within N'. (MECHANISM-AUDIT-2026-09-28, reconnect #6)

Every change is validated locally and once, and nothing continuously asserts the invariants between mechanisms, so humans are the detector: about 247 of 253 breaks were found by the operator or assistant. Build a joint registry with semantic invariants and a landing gate on the registered joints. (WHY-THINGS-KEEP-BREAKING)
The dominant failure is silence: contract drift, half-built joints, residue and stale validations account for 64% of breaks. (WHY-THINGS-KEEP-BREAKING)
Producer/consumer key mismatch: the loop runs but does not close, because growth-stage outputs land where the reuse-stage readers do not look. (SELF_DEVELOPMENT_WIRING_AUDIT 08-13)
Edit site plus falsifier must be mandatory at detection, with reward on verified closure. The gap-to-edit-to-land-to-verify lane was never specified. (SPEC-REVIEW-2026-09-27)
Unassisted reach must be a shape the system reads. Operator exact-edits under the Substrate Autonomous identity hide assistance, so reach must be split by author. (SPEC-REVIEW)
The spec ledger is not the source of truth; checkboxes drift both ways. (SPEC-REVIEW)
A brake must be deterministic and exist before an LLM is needed, because a storm consumes the LLM plane. (SELF-CONTAINMENT-EVALUATION)
Containment must be a shape (a quarantine with a TTL) read at admission, not an operator habit such as mask, stop or restart. (SELF-CONTAINMENT)
Refuse unattributed work: without lineage it cannot be graded, attributed or cancelled. (SELF-CONTAINMENT)
Test at the layer that consumes the artifact. A passing check one layer up is evidence about a different system. The August setup reports list 8 instances. (SETUP_UX_REMAP, SETUP_AND_JOIN_DOC_DELTA)
